column1: Integrated genomic and proteomic analyses identify stimulus-dependent molecular changes associated with distinct modes of skeletal muscle atrophy
RNA Sequencing datasets and analysis. Values expressed represent the transcripts per kilobase million (TPM).

"-log10(P)" and "log2(FC)" represent the log transformed variables used for volcano plots. P is the adjusted P value, and FC is the fold change in levels compared to control. "SIG" indicates where P<0.05
"Aging" Contains the dataset comparing RNA sequencing from 6 month (Control) vs 24 month old (Old) TA muscles (n=3)
"Dexamethasone" Contains the dataset comparing RNA sequencing from untreated (Control) vs dexamethasone treated (Dexa) TA muscles (n=4)
"LLC" Contains the dataset comparing RNA sequencing from non-tumour controls (Control) vs LLC tumour mouse (LLC) TA muscles (n=3)
"Cross-comparisons" contains the log2FC for transcripts detected in all three treatments for cross-comparison purposes
"Fig2 Heatmap" contains transformed data of selected differentially expressed genes color coded by change in expression used for the Figure 2 Heatmap
